# arin_irr_route_set (Resource)

An IRR route-set object.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Required

- `descriptions` (List of String)
- `name` (String) Set name, RS- prefixed, optionally ASN-scoped
  (AS64496:RS-EXAMPLE).

### Optional

- `mbrs_by_ref` (Set of String)
- `members` (Set of String) IPv4 prefixes or route-set names.
- `mp_members` (Set of String) Prefixes of either family or route-set names.
- `remarks` (List of String)

### Read-Only

- `admin_pocs` (Set of String) Admin POC handles. System generated by ARIN from
  the org.
- `created` (String)
- `last_modified` (String)
- `org_handle` (String)
- `routing_pocs` (Set of String) Routing POC handles. System generated by ARIN
  from the org.
- `tech_pocs` (Set of String) Tech POC handles. System generated by ARIN from
  the org.
